WITH (SELECT toYear(MAX(DateKey)) FROM retail.FactOnlineSales) AS current_year,
days AS (
    SELECT
        CalendarYear AS yr,
        CalendarQuarterLabel AS quarter_label,
        count() AS day_count
    FROM retail.DimDate
    WHERE CalendarYear IN (current_year, current_year - 1)
    GROUP BY yr, quarter_label
),
sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.CalendarYear AS yr,
        d.CalendarQuarterLabel AS quarter_label,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (current_year, current_year - 1)
    GROUP BY yr, quarter_label
)
SELECT
    cur.quarter_label AS `季度`,
    round(cur.sales_amount / cur_days.day_count, 2) AS `今年日均销售额`,
    round(prev.sales_amount / prev_days.day_count, 2) AS `去年日均销售额`,
    round(cur.sales_amount / cur_days.day_count - prev.sales_amount / prev_days.day_count, 2) AS `同比增减额`,
    round(
        (cur.sales_amount / cur_days.day_count - prev.sales_amount / prev_days.day_count)
        / nullIf(prev.sales_amount / prev_days.day_count, 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS `同比增长率%`
FROM sales AS cur
INNER JOIN days AS cur_days
    ON cur.yr = current_year
   AND cur.quarter_label = cur_days.quarter_label
INNER JOIN sales AS prev
    ON prev.yr = current_year - 1
   AND prev.quarter_label = cur.quarter_label
INNER JOIN days AS prev_days
    ON prev_days.yr = current_year - 1
   AND prev_days.quarter_label = cur.quarter_label
WHERE cur.yr = current_year
ORDER BY cur.quarter_label;

WITH contoso_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.SalesOrderNumber AS order_no,
        s.ProductKey AS product_key,
        p.ProductName AS product_name
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS s
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    WHERE toYear(s.DateKey) = 2009
      AND p.Manufacturer = 'Contoso'
),
product_orders AS (
    SELECT
        product_key,
        count(DISTINCT order_no) AS order_cnt
    FROM contoso_sales
    GROUP BY product_key
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT count(DISTINCT order_no) AS total_order_cnt
    FROM contoso_sales
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT
        a.product_key AS product1_key,
        a.product_name AS product1_name,
        b.product_key AS product2_key,
        b.product_name AS product2_name,
        count(DISTINCT a.order_no) AS common_order_cnt
    FROM contoso_sales AS a
    INNER JOIN contoso_sales AS b
        ON a.order_no = b.order_no
       AND a.product_key < b.product_key
    GROUP BY
        product1_key,
        product1_name,
        product2_key,
        product2_name
),
pair_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.product1_key,
        p.product1_name,
        p.product2_key,
        p.product2_name,
        p.common_order_cnt,
        p.common_order_cnt * 1.0 * (SELECT total_order_cnt FROM total_orders)
            / nullIf(o1.order_cnt * o2.order_cnt, 0) AS lift
    FROM pairs AS p
    INNER JOIN product_orders AS o1
        ON p.product1_key = o1.product_key
    INNER JOIN product_orders AS o2
        ON p.product2_key = o2.product_key
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        row_number() OVER (
            ORDER BY common_order_cnt DESC, lift DESC, product1_key, product2_key
        ) AS rank_no,
        product1_name,
        product2_name,
        common_order_cnt,
        lift
    FROM pair_metrics
)
SELECT
    rank_no AS `名次`,
    product1_name AS `产品1`,
    product2_name AS `产品2`,
    common_order_cnt AS `共同订单数`,
    lift AS `提升度`
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_no <= 10
ORDER BY rank_no

prod_orders AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        count() AS order_cnt
    FROM order_products
    GROUP BY ProductKey
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber) AS total_order_cnt
    FROM order_products
),
pair_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.ProductKey AS p1,
        b.ProductKey AS p2,
        count() AS common_orders
    FROM order_products a
    INNER JOIN order_products b
        ON a.SalesOrderNumber = b.SalesOrderNumber
       AND a.ProductKey < b.ProductKey
    GROUP BY p1, p2
),
pair_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        pc.p1,
        pc.p2,
        pc.common_orders,
        pc.common_orders * t.total_order_cnt / nullIf(po1.order_cnt * po2.order_cnt, 0) AS lift
    FROM pair_counts pc
    INNER JOIN prod_orders po1 ON pc.p1 = po1.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN prod_orders po2 ON pc.p2 = po2.ProductKey
    CROSS JOIN total_orders t
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY pm.common_orders DESC, pm.lift DESC) AS `名次`,
    dp1.ProductName AS `产品1`,
    dp2.ProductName AS `产品2`,
    pm.common_orders AS `共同订单数`,
    round(pm.lift, 4) AS `提升度`
FROM pair_metrics pm
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct dp1 ON pm.p1 = dp1.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct dp2 ON pm.p2 = dp2.ProductKey
ORDER BY pm.common_orders DESC, pm.lift DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH
    contoso_products AS (
        SELECT ProductKey, ProductName
        FROM retail.DimProduct
        WHERE BrandName = 'Contoso'
    ),
    total_orders_2009 AS (
        SELECT count(DISTINCT SalesOrderNumber) AS total_orders
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    ),
    order_product AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            s.SalesOrderNumber AS order_no,
            s.ProductKey AS product_key
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s
        INNER JOIN contoso_products p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        WHERE toYear(s.DateKey) = 2009
    ),
    product_order_counts AS (
        SELECT product_key, count() AS order_count
        FROM order_product
        GROUP BY product_key
    ),
    pair_counts AS (
        SELECT
            a.product_key AS product_key_a,
            b.product_key AS product_key_b,
            count() AS common_orders
        FROM order_product a
        INNER JOIN order_product b
            ON a.order_no = b.order_no
           AND a.product_key < b.product_key
        GROUP BY a.product_key, b.product_key
    ),
    pair_metrics AS (
        SELECT
            pa.ProductName AS product_a,
            pb.ProductName AS product_b,
            pc.common_orders AS common_orders,
            pc.common_orders * t.total_orders
                / nullIf(poca.order_count * pocb.order_count, 0) AS lift
        FROM pair_counts pc
        INNER JOIN contoso_products pa ON pc.product_key_a = pa.ProductKey
        INNER JOIN contoso_products pb ON pc.product_key_b = pb.ProductKey
        INNER JOIN product_order_counts poca ON pc.product_key_a = poca.product_key
        INNER JOIN product_order_counts pocb ON pc.product_key_b = pocb.product_key
        CROSS JOIN total_orders_2009 t
    )
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (
        ORDER BY common_orders DESC, lift DESC, product_a, product_b
    ) AS rank_no,
    product_a,
    product_b,
    common_orders,
    lift
FROM pair_metrics
ORDER BY common_orders DESC, lift DESC, product_a, product_b
LIMIT 10;

WITH
    cogs AS
    (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(TotalCost) AS cogs
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    inv_daily AS
    (
        SELECT
            i.DateKey,
            i.ProductKey,
            sum(i.OnHandQuantity * coalesce(p.UnitCost, 0)) AS inventory_value
        FROM retail.FactInventory AS i
        INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
            ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        WHERE toYear(i.DateKey) = 2009
        GROUP BY i.DateKey, i.ProductKey
    ),
    avg_inv AS
    (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            avg(inventory_value) AS avg_inventory_value
        FROM inv_daily
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    product_keys AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT ProductKey
        FROM
        (
            SELECT ProductKey FROM cogs
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ProductKey FROM avg_inv
        )
    )
SELECT
    p.ProductKey AS `产品编码`,
    p.ProductName AS `产品名称`,
    coalesce(c.cogs, 0) AS `COGS`,
    a.avg_inventory_value AS `平均库存价值`,
    coalesce(c.cogs, 0) / nullIf(a.avg_inventory_value, 0) AS `库存周转率`,
    rank() OVER (
        ORDER BY coalesce(c.cogs, 0) / nullIf(a.avg_inventory_value, 0) DESC
    ) AS `名次`
FROM product_keys AS k
LEFT JOIN cogs AS c ON k.ProductKey = c.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN avg_inv AS a ON k.ProductKey = a.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON k.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
ORDER BY `库存周转率` DESC, p.ProductName

        cat.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,

    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f

                PARTITION BY ProductCategoryKey
                ORDER BY Year
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
            ),
            2

    FROM yearly

ORDER BY ProductCategoryName, Year;

WITH quarterly AS (

        cat.ProductCategoryName AS category_name,
        d.CalendarQuarterLabel AS quarter_label,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS quarter_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS sc
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = sc.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS cat
        ON sc.ProductCategoryKey = cat.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2009
      AND cat.ProductCategoryName IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        cat.ProductCategoryName,
        d.CalendarQuarterLabel
),
annual AS (
    SELECT
        category_name,
        sum(quarter_sales) AS annual_sales
    FROM quarterly
    GROUP BY category_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        q.category_name,
        q.quarter_label,
        q.quarter_sales,
        a.annual_sales,
        q.quarter_sales * 100.0 / nullIf(a.annual_sales, 0) AS dependence_pct,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY q.category_name
            ORDER BY q.quarter_sales DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM quarterly AS q
    INNER JOIN annual AS a
        ON q.category_name = a.category_name
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dependence_pct DESC) AS `名次`,
    category_name AS `产品品类`,
    quarter_label AS `依赖季度`,
    quarter_sales AS `该季度销售额`,
    annual_sales AS `全年销售额`,
    round(dependence_pct, 2) AS `依赖程度(%)`
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY dependence_pct DESC;

WITH quarterly AS (
    SELECT
        dc.ProductCategoryKey AS ProductCategoryKey,
        dc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
        dd.CalendarYear AS Year,
        dd.CalendarQuarterLabel AS QuarterLabel,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS QuarterSales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS dd
        ON f.DateKey = dd.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS sc
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = sc.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS dc
        ON sc.ProductCategoryKey = dc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        dc.ProductCategoryKey,
        dc.ProductCategoryName,
        dd.CalendarYear,
        dd.CalendarQuarterLabel
),
annual AS (
    SELECT
        ProductCategoryKey,
        ProductCategoryName,
        Year,
        sum(QuarterSales) AS AnnualSales
    FROM quarterly
    GROUP BY ProductCategoryKey, ProductCategoryName, Year
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        q.ProductCategoryKey,
        q.ProductCategoryName,
        q.Year,
        q.QuarterLabel,
        q.QuarterSales,
        a.AnnualSales,
        q.QuarterSales / nullIf(a.AnnualSales, 0) AS Share
    FROM quarterly AS q
    INNER JOIN annual AS a
        ON q.ProductCategoryKey = a.ProductCategoryKey
       AND q.Year = a.Year
),
peaks AS (
    SELECT
        ProductCategoryKey,
        ProductCategoryName,
        Year,
        QuarterLabel,
        QuarterSales,
        AnnualSales,
        Share,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ProductCategoryKey
            ORDER BY Share DESC, Year DESC, QuarterLabel ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY Share DESC) AS `Rank`,
    ProductCategoryName,
    Year AS PeakYear,
    QuarterLabel AS PeakQuarter,
    QuarterSales AS PeakQuarterSales,
    AnnualSales,
    round(Share * 100, 2) AS DependencyPercent
FROM peaks
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY Share DESC, ProductCategoryName;

        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales

        FROM retail.DimDate d

        WHERE d.DateKey BETWEEN b.min_d AND b.max_d
          AND d.IsWorkDay IN ('WorkDay', 'WeekEnd')
    ),
    day_counts AS (
        SELECT IsWorkDay, count() AS n
        FROM days
        GROUP BY IsWorkDay
    ),
    cat_sales AS (
        SELECT
            pc.ProductCategoryName,
            sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') AS weekend_sales,
            sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') AS workday_sales
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
        INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
        INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
        INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
        WHERE d.IsWorkDay IN ('WorkDay', 'WeekEnd')
        GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
    )
SELECT
    c.ProductCategoryName,
    c.weekend_sales / nullIf(w.n, 0) AS avg_weekend_day_sales,
    c.workday_sales / nullIf(dc.n, 0) AS avg_workday_sales,
    (c.weekend_sales / nullIf(w.n, 0)) - (c.workday_sales / nullIf(dc.n, 0)) AS difference_amount,
    ((c.weekend_sales / nullIf(w.n, 0)) - (c.workday_sales / nullIf(dc.n, 0))) * 100.0

FROM cat_sales c

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    ifNull(pc.ProductCategoryName, '未知') AS category_name,
    f.DateKey,
    d.IsWorkDay,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS daily_sales
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
  INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON toFloat64(ps.ProductSubcategoryKey) = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
  GROUP BY ifNull(pc.ProductCategoryName, '未知'), f.DateKey, d.IsWorkDay
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    ifNull(avgIf(daily_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd'), 0) AS weekend_avg,
    ifNull(avgIf(daily_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'), 0) AS workday_avg
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT
  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY weekend_avg - workday_avg DESC) AS `名次`,
  category_name AS `产品品类`,
  round(weekend_avg, 2) AS `平均周末日销售额`,
  round(workday_avg, 2) AS `平均工作日销售额`,
  round(weekend_avg - workday_avg, 2) AS `差额`,
  round((weekend_avg - workday_avg) * 100.0 / nullIf(workday_avg, 0), 2) AS `差额百分比`
FROM metrics
ORDER BY `名次`;
